tasks.title: Days between dates
tasks.statement: Write a function days_between(a, b): how many days from date a to date b (may be negative). The dates are strings «YYYY-MM-DD».

tasks.title: Add days
tasks.statement: Write a function add_days(day, n): the date n days later (n may be negative). The input and the result are strings «YYYY-MM-DD».

tasks.title: Date in the Russian style
tasks.statement: Write a function format_ru(day): from «YYYY-MM-DD» produce «DD.MM.YYYY». Use datetime and strftime.

tasks.title: Day of the week
tasks.statement: Write a function weekday_name(day): the English name of the day of the week (monday, tuesday, ...) for a date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.

tasks.title: Age
tasks.statement: Write a function age(born, today): the number of full years between the date of birth and the date «today» (strings «YYYY-MM-DD»). If the birthday has not yet come this year, that year does not count.
tasks.hint: years = today.year - born.year; if (today.month, today.day) < (born.month, born.day), subtract 1.

tasks.title: Workdays
tasks.statement: Write a function workdays(start, end): how many weekdays (Mon-Fri) are in the range from start to end inclusive. The dates are strings «YYYY-MM-DD».
tasks.hint: Loop from start to end and count the days where weekday() < 5.

tasks.title: Last day of the month
tasks.statement: Write a function last_day(year, month): the number of days in the month. Use the calendar module.

tasks.title: From UTC to local
tasks.statement: Write a function to_offset(iso_utc, hours): the time «YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM» given in UTC, convert it to the zone with an offset of hours hours and return it as a string «YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM». Use timezone and timedelta.

tasks.title: A log line
tasks.statement: Write a function parse_log(line): a log line like «2024-03-05 09:07:03 ERROR disk failure». Return a tuple (the time in ISO format with the letter T, the level).
tasks.hint: date_part, time_part, level, *_ = line.split(); datetime.fromisoformat(date_part + ' ' + time_part).isoformat().
